gui.reason: CLI-only diagnostics; no new BuildPlan field or GUI option.

input_constraints: User-owned USA XISO with pinned retail HUD resources; padded images are read through logical XDVDFS extents.
Use a separate output copy and a clean retail source for each profile. v7/v1 and different profiles refuse rather than migrating mixed bytes.
Pair includes TB, NE and neutral fallback in both orientations; transport and resources install no runtime hooks.
portme: Apply the r62 scorebug section of WIRING.md, disable automatic runtime selection and regenerate the protected reservation manifest.
Run the six-profile matrix and static 4:3/widescreen witness list in ASTRA_SCOREBUG_FIX_REPORT.md.

public_distribution.rule: Distribute the compiler and recipes; derive native resources from the user's own disc. Do not distribute generated game resources, executables or discs.

runtime.scope: The earlier v1 runtime build froze entering gameplay in xemu on macOS; that failure is not reproduced or fixed here. v2 has bounded native collection, allocation, decompression, lookup and event checks. OS asynchronous lifetime, GPU consumption and live memory pressure remain unproved.

fields.allowed: transport | hooks | resources | neutral | pair | full
fields.name: runtime_probe

selectors.notes: CLI --runtime-probe selects the profile. --runtime is shorthand for full. Pair is TB/NE plus neutral. Status requires the matching profile. No additional allocator owner.

source_container.format: XBE and native TXTR/SCNE resources in XDVDFS pack 0
source_container.resource: owned RX/RW hook allocations plus HUD outer 346 and its archive index
source_container.retail_file: user-owned default.xbe and vc_53450030/0 in an NFL 2K5 USA disc
